_doc.what: How standing shows and is read in this world (engine/bearing.py and engine/texture.py read this; they hold no world words). Source: bible Part III 2.1 (Deference). Every number is a design figure named in design_figures.json.
_doc.forms: Forms of deference. due_to: any condition matching the man deferred to; a condition has kind (org kind), roles (seat roles), min_age. scope: own = the one showing it belongs to the same organisation as the man deferred to; other = he belongs to another; any = either. known_kind: the org kind whose men learn it (inducted men know it; others learn through time in the life). setting: place kinds where it is apt (omitted = anywhere).
_doc.retinue: Per seat role: who attends him (from_roles = roles of the men who attend, mean = design figure for how many). Recorded once so the crew persists.
_doc.violent_event_types: Substrings of event types that weigh as violence or arrest.
_doc.channels: Words for how news reaches him (read, told, talk, home).
_doc.core_marks: Bearing facts the GM is asked to propose when none is recorded (kind, ask).
_doc.readings: What a stranger reads from signals alone, by how much shows (low to high).
_doc.figures: Every number the presence and texture code uses, each a Design proposal (kept here, beside the data that names them, so a run reads them without a design draw).

forms.text: approaches with his head slightly bowed and takes the hand in both of his, or kisses it or the cheek; an old man with a ring may allow his hand to be kissed, and a modern head pulls it away
stands when he enters and does not sit until he sits
does not speak until spoken to, answers what is asked and volunteers no opinions; to interrupt him is to give offence
calls him 'the boss' or 'the old man', or 'Don' if Sicilian-born or after the tone
calls him 'Mr.' and the surname, or 'the gentleman', and never a nickname to his face
takes the lower end of the table, or stands, with the deputy and the adviser near the head and the captains by seniority
says nothing of the Family before women, children or strangers and uses no names on the telephone ('that thing', 'our friend', 'the gentleman')

core_marks.ask: how long he has been in the life

readings: a man who is plainly somebody

retinue_mean_head.note: unsourced; I1a: how many men attend a head of an organisation when he goes about (a draw around this, recorded once)

retinue_mean_second.note: unsourced; I1a: how many men attend a head's deputy

retinue_mean_unit.note: unsourced; I1a: how many men attend the leader of a unit

recog_base.note: unsourced; I1a: a stranger placing a man he has never been told about

recog_familiarity.note: unsourced; I1a: placing a man through dealings with him

recog_years.note: unsourced; I1a: placing a man through time in the life (saturating, 1 - exp(-years/2))

recog_retinue.note: unsourced; I1a: each visible attendant makes a man easier to place

recog_signals.note: unsourced; I1a: each worn or arriving-with signal

recog_told.note: unsourced; I1a: he has been told of the man

recog_fame.note: unsourced; I1a: the man is widely known

reading_band.note: unsourced; I1a: how much evidence moves a stranger one step up the readings of a man he cannot place

form_prior.note: unsourced; I1a: knowing a custom with no time in the life

form_per_year.note: unsourced; I1a: learning customs through time in the life, 1 - exp(-rate * years)

form_inducted.note: unsourced; I1a: a man taken in knows the customs

form_right_respect.note: unsourced; I1a: regard earned by the right form

form_right_trust.note: unsourced; I1a: trust earned by the right form

form_wrong_resent.note: unsourced; I1a: resentment from a form missed or got wrong

form_wrong_respect.note: unsourced; I1a: regard lost by a form missed or got wrong

form_witness_share.note: unsourced; I1a: the share of the effect that falls on onlookers

spend_free_ratio.note: unsourced; I1a: outflow over purse plus outflow above which he reads as spending freely

beyond_means_ratio.note: unsourced; I1a: a display costing more than this times his purse is beyond his means

in_life_entry_age.note: unsourced; I1a: age at which a man of the opening is taken to have entered the life

sig_base.note: unsourced; I1a: a happening's baseline significance

sig_sev.note: unsourced; I1a: severity of the happening

sig_circle.note: unsourced; I1a: it touches his kin, household, men or people he knows (scaled by closeness)

reach_base.note: unsourced; I1a: a public happening reaching him with nothing else behind it

reach_circle.note: unsourced; I1a: it touches people close to him (scaled by closeness)

reach_habit.note: unsourced; I1a: he keeps a habit that carries news (a paper, the radio)

push_attention.note: unsourced; I1a: how much significance one call carries before the rest waits for the next (the rest is returned later, never dropped)

push_age_gain.note: unsourced; I1a: an unshown item grows heavier each day it waits
